title: Editing or Deleting an Object from the AD Change Detection Object Safelist

blocks.text: You can edit or delete an Active Directory (AD) change detection object that is marked safe from the AD Change Detection Object Safelist.

blocks.heading: Editing an AD Change Detection Object from the Safelist

blocks.text: To edit an AD change detection object from the safelist:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Settings > AD Change Detection Object Safelist.
Select a tenant from the Result for drop-down menu.
Locate the change detection object you want to edit, and under Actions, click the Edit icon.
Make changes to the Reason or the Expiry field as required.

blocks.heading: Deleting an AD Change Detection Object from the Safelist

blocks.text: To delete an AD change detection object from the safelist:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Settings > AD Change Detection Object Safelist.
Select a tenant from the Result for drop-down menu.
Locate the change detection object you want to remove, and under Actions, click the Delete icon.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
When you remove an object from the safelist, it gets added to the AD Change Detection dashboard.
